title: Authentication
content_data:
With the authorization code you receive after authorization by the TikTok account user (the business), you can make a request to the following endpoint to get an `access_token` for subsequent API requests and a `refresh_token` for access token renewal. To get the TikTok account permission scopes that are authorized by the business, you can pass the generated access token to [/tt_user/token_info/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1765927978092545). **Access token expiry** The `access_token` is valid for one day. Once an access token has expired, you need to make a request to this endpoint to renew the access token. Remember to pass in the `refresh_token` for a token renewal request. **Refresh token expiry** The `refresh_token` is valid for one year. If the refresh token expires, the developer needs to request the user to re-authorize their application via the user authorization workflow. To get or renew the TikTok account access token, you can use /tt_user/oauth2/token/ and /tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/ respectively. Note that these endpoints require `redirect_uri` for better security. # Obtain an access token Use this endpoint to obtain an `access_token`. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type
Allowed format: `"application/json"` | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |client_id{Required}|string| ID of your developer application (App ID).

To obtain the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |client_secret{Required}|string|Secret of your developer application.

To obtain the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |grant_type{Required}|string|The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:
  • `authorization_code`: To generate the access token by authorization code.
| |auth_code{Required}|string|The authorization code in the callback URL. An authorization code is appened to the redirect URL after the business has logged into TikTok and approves your request for permissions.

To find out how to get the authorization code, see [Authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825103730490434).| |redirect_uri{Required}|string|The redirect URL which the business will be directed to. Its value must be the same as the TikTok account holder redirect URL specified in your developer App.

To obtain the TikTok account holder redirect URL, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/token/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_id":"{{client_id}}", "client_secret":"{{client_secret}}", "grant_type":"authorization_code", "auth_code":"{{auth_code}}", "redirect_uri":"{{redirect_uri}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|access_token|string|Business access token to call [Mention endpoints](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825107837430850). | #|token_type|string|Token type.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope|string|Scope of permissions that the application has access to.| #|expires_in|number|How long until access token expires, in seconds.| #|refresh_token|string|Refresh token to renew access token.

Note: Maintain this field for `access_token` renewal.| #|refresh_token_expires_in|number|How long until refresh token expires, in seconds.| #|open_id|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86400, "open_id": "{{open_id}}", "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 31536000, "scope": "message.list.manage,video.list,video.insights,user.insights,user.info.basic,comment.list,biz.brand.insights,biz.spark.auth,tcm.order.update,comment.list.manage,video.upload,video.publish,biz.ads.recommend,user.account.type,biz.creator.info,user.info.username,message.list.send,user.info.profile,user.info.stats,message.list.read,biz.creator.insights", "token_type": "Bearer" } } (/code) ``` # Renew an access token Use this endpoint to renew an access token by `refresh_token`. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type
Allowed format: `"application/json"` | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |client_id{Required}|string| ID of your developer application (App ID).

To obtain the App ID, navigate to App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |client_secret{Required}|string|Secret of your developer application.

To obtain the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |grant_type{Required}|string|The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:

  • `refresh_token`: To generate the access token by refresh token.
| |refresh_token{Required}|string|Refresh token to renew an existing access token.

You can find the token in the response of /tt_user/oauth2/token/ when you generate an access token.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_id":"{{client_id}}", "client_secret":"{{client_secret}}", "grant_type":"refresh_token", "refresh_token":"{{refresh_token}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data|object|Returned data.| #|access_token|string|Business access token to call [Mention endpoints](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825107837430850). | #|token_type|string|Token type.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope|string|Scope of permissions that the application has access to.| #|expires_in|number|How long until access token expires, in seconds.| #|refresh_token|string|Refresh token to renew access token.

Note: Maintain this field for `access_token` renewal.| #|refresh_token_expires_in|number|How long until refresh token expires, in seconds.| #|open_id|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86400, "open_id": "{{open_id}}", "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 28484364, "scope": "message.list.manage,video.list,video.insights,user.insights,user.info.basic,comment.list,biz.brand.insights,biz.spark.auth,tcm.order.update,comment.list.manage,video.upload,video.publish,biz.ads.recommend,user.account.type,biz.creator.info,user.info.username,message.list.send,user.info.profile,user.info.stats,message.list.read,biz.creator.insights", "token_type": "Bearer" } } (/code) ```
